theme.title: NBA Mix 24
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: How many games did Miami win before the 2020 Bubble playoffs?
questions.context: Heat · Jimmy Butler's first season · shortened schedule
questions.note: 44 regular-season wins, then a surprise Finals appearance.

funFacts.text: This was Miami's first complete season without retired Dwyane Wade.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: It was the first time since 2016-17 that Dwyane Wade was not on the Miami Heat roster

funFacts.text: Jimmy Butler was in his first season with Miami.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: It was the first season for Jimmy Butler on the Heat

funFacts.text: Miami was among twenty-two teams invited to the NBA bubble.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Heat were one of 22 teams invited to the NBA Bubble

questions.prompt: What was LeBron James's scoring average in the 2016 Finals, when he was named MVP?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after averaging 29.7 points, 11.3 rebounds, 8.9 assists, 2.6 steals, and 2.3 blocks.

funFacts.text: LeBron also averaged 11.3 rebounds and 8.9 assists per game in that series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: averaging 29.7 points, 11.3 rebounds, 8.9 assists, 2.6 steals, and 2.3 blocks

funFacts.text: He became the first player to lead an entire Finals series in points, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: lead all players in a playoff series in points, rebounds, assists, steals, and blocks

funFacts.text: Every Finals MVP voter picked LeBron after Cleveland's comeback title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James was unanimously voted the NBA Finals Most Valuable Player

questions.prompt: How many points did Kobe Bryant score in his final NBA game, at age 37?
questions.note: 60, the oldest player ever to score 60.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the oldest is Bryant (60 points; 37 years and 234 days)

funFacts.text: The Lakers later retired both of Kobe's jersey numbers, an unprecedented honor for one NBA player.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: making him the only NBA player to have multiple numbers retired by one franchise

funFacts.text: Kobe had entered the league straight from high school and won a slam dunk contest while still a teenager.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: won the 1997 Slam Dunk Contest, the youngest dunk champion at age 18

funFacts.text: His final seasons were repeatedly interrupted by injuries after the end of his championship years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His remaining playing career was hampered by injuries and reduced playing time

questions.prompt: How many rebounds did Wes Unseld grab in Game 2 of the 1975 Finals?
questions.context: Washington Bullets at Golden State · 1975 Finals
questions.note: 20 rebounds, but Washington lost the game by a single point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rebs: Wes Unseld 20

funFacts.text: Jamaal Wilkes's undersized but effective defense on Elvin Hayes proved decisive.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the defensive play of the seemingly undersized Jamaal Wilkes on Bullets' power forward Elvin Hayes

funFacts.text: Reserve center George Johnson added 10 points and nine rebounds in Game 3.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: backup center George Johnson had 10 points and nine rebounds off the bench

funFacts.text: Rick Barry had 38 points in Game 3 as the Warriors moved within a win of the title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rick Barry poured in 38 points

questions.prompt: Detroit set a Finals record for the fewest turnovers in a game in 2005. How many did it commit?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Collectively, the Spurs shot 37% and committed 17 turnovers to the Pistons' NBA Finals-record four.

funFacts.text: Detroit used its bench to devastating effect, with Lindsey Hunter and Antonio McDyess producing efficient minutes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: especially efficient bench performances by Lindsey Hunter and Antonio McDyess

funFacts.text: The Pistons' defense limited almost every Spurs shooter to poor efficiency in the pivotal home game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: only Tony Parker (6–13, 46.2% shooting) managed to surpass the 45% mark

funFacts.text: San Antonio and Detroit had been the NBA's premier defensive teams throughout the preceding seasons.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the two premier defensive teams of that era
